content.bridge_context: We look at the world through geometry, identifying symmetry and logical patterns in nature and art.

units.title: Rotational Symmetry
units.explanation: A shape has rotational symmetry if it looks the same after being turned around its center (e.g., 1/2 turn, 1/4 turn).
units.dual_language_instruction: Identify the turn. / मोड़ की पहचान करें।

units.title: Number Patterns
units.explanation: A sequence of numbers that follow a specific rule, like adding 5 or doubling the previous number.
